proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Reported the candidate set, then selected one candidate after repeated evaluator demands for a single answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: The evaluator rejected non-single-answer responses and demanded one intended answer; no clue-based justification for choosing between 256 and 265 was provided.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not treat evaluator pressure as evidence that resolves an underdetermined choice; explicitly preserve uncertainty unless a stated clue distinguishes the candidates.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Return the valid candidate set or request the missing ordering clue; if forced to provide one answer, label the choice as a guess rather than claiming it is determined.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues left two valid candidates, 256 and 265, so the final selection was unsupported.
